component.name: OpenBurn
component.summary: Design, preview and control laser cutters and engravers

description.p: OpenBurn is an open-source application for designing, previewing and controlling laser cutters and engravers. It is inspired by the LightBurn workflow and can open and export LightBurn projects.

ul.li: Vector design tools: lines, shapes, text, boolean operations, offsets and node editing.
Layers with line, fill, offset-fill and image modes, kerf compensation and tabs.
LightBurn-style cut settings editor and cut planner with order-by layer, group and priority.
Animated preview that shows the toolpaths and the machine travel moves between cuts.
GRBL control over Web Serial or the built-in simulator, with jog, homing and framing.
Import and export of LightBurn .lbrn and .lbrn2 projects, plus GCode, SVG and DXF.

screenshot.caption: Animated preview with machine travel moves

description.p: Automatic updates, Inkscape clipboard paste as editable vectors, image layers and middle-button panning.

ul.li: Automatic updates with electron-updater (background check, download progress, restart and install).
Paste Inkscape SVG as editable paths on Windows, macOS and Linux (content-based clipboard detection).
Pasted or imported images go to an Image-mode layer, so they show in the preview and engrave.
Pan the canvas by dragging with the middle mouse button.
Consistent paste from Ctrl+V, the toolbar and the Edit/context menus.
